featured_reviews.name: Akshay Malvankar
featured_reviews.review_text:
As a student navigating the corridors of Mumbai University, I am compelled to share a deeply disappointing experience that reflects systemic neglect and administrative apathy.
Despite being one of the largest universities in India, the management here operates with alarming inefficiency. Students are routinely subjected to long queues, unresolved grievances, and a complete lack of accountability. The grievance redressal mechanism is virtually non-existent—when asked about it, staff either deny its existence or redirect students to the Board of Examinations, which itself remains inaccessible and unresponsive.
Staff members are frequently "on lunch break" or "in meetings," and when available, their tone is often dismissive or outright rude. Doors are shut during working hours while students wait outside, seeking basic assistance. Emails sent to official departments go unanswered, and technical issues plague even the simplest processes—from mark sheets to exam forms.
The quality of education, sadly, mirrors this dysfunction. There is little regard for student welfare, dignity, or timely resolution. The culture seems to prioritize internal comfort over public service, with staff enjoying leisurely breaks funded by student fees, while students struggle for clarity and support.
Mumbai University must urgently introspect and reform. Students deserve respect, transparency, and a functioning system—not bureaucratic indifference masked as procedure

It’s a memorable moment to enter into this IIT. It’s been a 5-month-long journey of NEC, and after that we secured the 156th rank in the Basic Track of the NEC Challenge, which itself is a proud achievement for us—especially because my college is new to these kinds of national-level challenges. Stepping into IIT Bombay after this journey felt unreal and deeply satisfying.

Attending E-SUMMIT 2K25 at IIT Bombay was nothing short of inspiring. From the moment we entered the campus, the environment itself motivated us to think bigger, dream bolder, and work harder. The infrastructure, innovation culture, and energy of the place clearly show why IIT Bombay is a global hub for entrepreneurship and technology.

The sessions, speaker talks, startup showcases, and interactions with entrepreneurs and mentors were extremely insightful. Listening to founders, investors, and industry leaders share their real-world experiences gave us clarity on how ideas turn into impactful startups. The exposure we gained here cannot be measured in words—it reshaped our mindset towards problem-solving, leadership, and innovation.

For a student coming from a college that is still growing in such ecosystems, this experience was truly empowering. Representing our institution at such a prestigious platform and standing among students from top colleges across the country gave us confidence and motivation to aim higher. The coordination, hospitality, and professionalism of the E-SUMMIT organizing team were excellent, making the entire event smooth and memorable.

Overall, IIT Bombay E-SUMMIT 2K25 was not just an event for us—it was a life-changing experience. It strengthened our belief that with consistency, teamwork, and vision, even students from new colleges can compete, learn, and grow on national platforms. This journey will remain a milestone in our academic and entrepreneurial life, and IIT Bombay will always hold a special place in our hearts.

⭐ Truly an unforgettable experience and a dream destination for every aspiring innovator and entrepreneur

featured_reviews.name: Utkarsh Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am currently inside the campus of Indian Institute of Technology Bombay, participating in Techfest on 22 December 2025, and the experience has been truly unforgettable. IIT Bombay is not just an educational institute, it is an ecosystem of innovation, discipline, and excellence. The campus is vast, green, and beautifully maintained, offering a calm and inspiring environment despite being located in the heart of Mumbai.

Techfest reflects the true spirit of IIT Bombay. From advanced technology exhibitions and robotics challenges to insightful talks and competitions, every event is well-organized and intellectually stimulating. The level of creativity, technical depth, and teamwork displayed by the students is outstanding. You can feel the passion for learning and problem-solving everywhere on campus.

The energy during Techfest is electrifying, with participants coming from different parts of India and even abroad. Volunteers and coordinators are extremely helpful, making the experience smooth and enjoyable. The infrastructure, hostels, academic blocks, and open spaces all reflect world-class standards.

Being here is highly motivating and gives a clear picture of why IIT Bombay is considered one of the finest institutions in the country. A truly inspiring place for anyone interested in technology, research, and innovation.

featured_reviews.name: ANKIT J KASHYAP
featured_reviews.review_text:
IIT Bombay is an excellent institute known for its academic excellence as well as for organizing high-quality and well-managed events. The campus is very beautiful, spacious, and has a great environment. During the fest, people from many different countries come to participate, which gives an international-level exposure.
The fest is organized only in December and is conducted for 3 days. In these three days, a large number of exciting and informative events take place. Army weapons are displayed, advanced robots are showcased, and events like Robo War, Robo Car Racing, and many other technical competitions are organized. These events are extremely interesting and educational, especially for IT and engineering students.
Along with technical events, there are many other activities that make the fest engaging and energetic. The registration process is smooth and is open from 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM, which is very convenient for participants.
Overall, IIT Bombay is an amazing place that provides learning, innovation, technology exposure, and global interaction all at one place.
Highly recommended for students interested in engineering, robotics, and technology. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Equally memorable were the simple moments, revisiting familiar spaces, sharing a relaxed dinner, and reconnecting with old friends. You could tell that a lot of people were working seriously behind the scenes to make the summit run smoothly.

The startup expo and network arena were the strongest parts of the summit. They felt purposeful rather than crowded or random, and the interactions were meaningful. The overall vibe was energetic but controlled, which is rare for events of this scale.

From my experience, the summit didn’t feel rushed or poorly managed at any point. The infrastructure of the campus supported the event well, making movement, networking, and participation comfortable throughout the day.

Overall, the combination of a well-run internal summit and a disciplined, well-kept campus made the experience genuinely positive and worth attending.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Hansraj Jivandas College of Education is truly one of the finest institutions for anyone who dreams of becoming a professional, confident, and compassionate teacher. If you are planning to pursue a B.Ed, I can wholeheartedly say that Hansraj Jivandas College of Education is the best choice you can make. It not only shapes you into a skilled educator but also into a better person. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Namrata Nayar
featured_reviews.review_text:
What should have been a review has become a eulogy, as I was just informed that Dr. Sampat is no more.

A great principal isn’t just a leader; they are a force. They shape minds, build character, and leave a mark so deep that even years later, their words echo in your heart.

Dr. Urmi Sampat was that kind of principal. She wasn’t just an educator,she was an institution.

I still remember my first day at H.J. College. She stood at the gate in a crisp cream saree, radiating authority yet warmth. “What’s your name?” she asked. “Namrata  , and I’m am going to be the topper this year,” I replied with pride. She just laughed and said, “Go and sit yourself inside.” That was Dr. Sampat, no fuss, no unnecessary praise, just straight to the point. But in that moment, she acknowledged me. And with her, an acknowledgment always meant something.

She had this aura about her,if she caught you in the corridor, you’d hold your breath. If you were exhaling, you wouldn’t dare inhale again until she passed. That was the kind of presence she had. But beneath that formidable exterior was someone who truly believed in her students.

I remember struggling in my psychology paper. She called me in and asked, “What the hell have you done?” I admitted, “I had a blackout.” She didn’t let me off easily. “I don’t believe in blackouts, but I believe in you,” she said. And that belief changed me. I promised her I wouldn’t let her down. And when I topped my methods, she awarded me the prestigious Miss H.J Title of the year. That moment shaped my future in ways I didn’t even realise at the time.

One of the greatest compliments I’ve ever received came from her:

Personally, I see a junior Dr. Urmi Sampat in Namrata.
That comparison still humbles me.

Everything she taught me stayed with me. From my first lesson at NPKT to my journey as a teacher at Arya Vidya Mandir Bandra, to moving to Dubai , her words have never left me. The discipline, the passion, the high standards,they are woven into the way I lead today.

I wish I had the chance to say goodbye. But in a way, someone like her never truly leaves. Somewhere, I know she’s making sure everyone arrives on time, does their job well, and carries themselves with the grace and dignity she expected of us all.

Dr. Sampat, you were the epitome of grace, excellence, and discipline. They don’t make them like you anymore. I treasured you, and I always will.
Yours truly,
Namrata Simon Nayar

Some points to keep in mind before taking admission here:

They get a FAT salary by the government and "train" those students who on average will get a paltry sum of salary and this perhaps give them a sense of excessive superiority. They are miserly tyrants as they will demand you to get their personal and unrelated errands (mazdoori) done for free. Don't know if the old principal who was unreachable to students except till the last day also treated them like that, but their nervousness infront of her betrayed a sign of incompetence.

True discipline is about following the rules which is good but these people are not concerned about rules and openly flout it e.g. wrongly confining the original documents, forcing students to do things that they are not required to according to the actual curriculum they paid the fees for, and some of them won't bat an eye to give mean degrading remarks. They forget that there's a Constitution which has certain rules for state-funded institutes.

3. The NAAC grade is a joke which they got by accommodating the officers in an expensive Juhu hotel (as proudly but ignorantly revealed by one "teacher")

4. The senior clerk Aditi Nerurkar is a hateful mean bigot (and possibly a psychopath) who seems to have been given a free hand by the college to be as such.

5. Teaching skills before joining this course won't be much different after completing it, and of course it will be because what can you learn when people (most teachers) who don't have subject content knowledge nor could they understand education in so many years, lectures you for hours 6 days a week and makes you study from poor content ripped off online. But you can become a drama artist (or dancer) because that's what happens often on priority.

6. Internships are held like the horrible show of big boss contest without any checks and balances for how students behave towards each other, but it's of not much concern to them of course because it doesn't affect them. It's majorly a total waste of time and you'll get the same repetitive feedback so basically you aren't growing as a teacher.

The only "strong point" of this course is the class presentation / speech which is simply about blabbering stuffs. Sadly, there isn't any good that I find here except maybe punctuality and obediance? featured_reviews.review_text:
This is a formal complaint regarding the extremely poor and unprofessional support experienced during my spouse’s Online MBA program at NMIMS.
During the admission phase, the assigned counselor (Amita) was highly persistent in calling and following up for enrollment and fee payment. However, immediately after the payment of substantial fees, the level of support dropped significantly.
A critical issue arose when the exam registration link was not functioning. When we contacted the counselor for assistance, instead of providing guidance, she responded in an inappropriate and dismissive manner, stating:
"Main kyun aapko bataun? Aap kabhi mera phone uthate ho kya?"
Such a response is unacceptable and raises serious concerns about the professionalism and accountability expected from an institution of this stature.
To clarify:
• Students are not obligated to respond to repeated follow-up calls.
• However, once enrolled and fees are paid, it is the institution’s responsibility to ensure proper academic support and guidance.
• Denying or delaying support on personal grounds is highly unprofessional.
This experience reflects a concerning gap between the admission process and post-admission student support.
I urge NMIMS to:
Review the conduct of its counseling staff
Establish accountability in student support systems
Ensure that students receive timely and respectful assistance
If such issues are not addressed, it can significantly impact the trust and credibility of the institution.

Wilson College is a timeless gem nestled along Mumbai’s iconic Girgaon Chowpatty.  The moment you step onto campus, you're greeted by stunning Gothic architecture—arched verandahs, teakwood trusses, and mosaic tile flooring that reflect its 19th-century heritage.  The classrooms, with their deep verandahs, offer breathtaking views of the Arabian Sea, making every lecture feel like a serene escape.

The college's library is a highlight, featuring
teakwood mezzanines and catwalks that exude old-world charm.  The assembly hall, adorned with stained glass and ornate balconies, adds to the campus's grandeur.  Beyond its aesthetics, Wilson College fosters a vibrant community spirit, especially evident during events like the POLARIS intercollege fest.

featured_reviews.review_text:
My Journey at M.L. Dahanukar College of Commerce

As a proud alumnus of Parle Tilak Vidyalaya Association's M.L. Dahanukar College of Commerce, I can confidently say that this institution has played a significant role in shaping who I am today—both professionally and personally. Nestled in the heart of Vile Parle (East), Mumbai, Dahanukar College stands as a symbol of academic excellence, discipline, and vibrant student life.

A Legacy of Excellence

Established in 1960, M.L. Dahanukar College has a rich legacy of over six decades in the field of commerce education. Named after the well-known industrialist and philanthropist Late Shri Madhavji Laxmidas Dahanukar, the college is managed by the reputed Parle Tilak Vidyalaya Association (PTVA). The institution has grown consistently, adapting to the changing educational landscape while staying grounded in its values.

Academics and Faculty

The college offers a wide range of undergraduate and postgraduate programs, including B.Com, BMS, BAF, BBI, BFM, and M.Com. The faculty members are not only well-qualified but also deeply committed to student success. Their teaching style is a perfect blend of theory and real-world applications, making lectures both informative and engaging.

Vibrant Campus Life

One of my fondest memories is participating in college festivals like "Kurukshetra", which brought out the best in us—teamwork, creativity, leadership, and a sense of community. From cultural events to seminars and NSS/NCC activities, the college provides an ideal environment for all-round development.

Infrastructure and Support

The college has excellent infrastructure with well-equipped classrooms, a computer lab, a library with a vast collection of books and journals, and a student-friendly environment. The administrative staff is also very cooperative and supportive, making student life smooth and hassle-free.

Alumni Pride

As an alumnus, I always carry the values and lessons I learned here with great pride. M.L. Dahanukar is not just a college—it’s a place where careers are nurtured, confidence is built, and dreams are turned into reality. It has produced many successful professionals across fields like finance, management, education, entrepreneurship, and civil services.

Conclusion:
Looking back, I feel grateful to be a part of this institution. The knowledge, skills, and values I received here continue to guide me in my journey. If you’re looking for a college that offers academic strength, a supportive environment, and vibrant student life, M.L. Dahanukar College of Commerce is the place to be.
